newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela cleared $892 mln on CANTV share issue.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela cleared $892 mln on CANTV share issue.

text.p: The Venezuelan government raised $891.85 million, after deducting commissions, through the sale of most of its 49 percent stake in national telephone company CANTV last week, a top government official said Wednesday.
Venezuelan Investment Fund (FIV) President Alberto Poletto told a news conference the global issue saw the sale of 312.4 million shares for a total of $1.026 billion.
Poletto had said on Tuesday that the CANTV issue had raised $1.16 billion.
A total of 239.4 million were sold in international markets, of which 143.64 million were in the United States and 95.76 million in Europe and the rest of the world, Poletto said.
In Venezuela, 73 million shares were sold representing $239.86 million.
